title: Signal to find issues - Arize AX Docs
markdown:
**Signal**reviews your traces on a schedule and groups recurring failures into ranked

**issues**, each with the pattern, the affected traces, and a proposed fix.

Signal is on every plan, with a monthly issue limit per tier. At the limit it pauses until the next month. See pricing and usage.

## Turn on Signal

In your project, select
**Signal**and click

**Enable Signal**. It reviews new traces every 6 hours by default and files anything recurring as an issue.

## Read your first issue

Each issue has an
**overview**of the pattern, the

**evidence**traces (open them in the trace view), and a

**proposed fix**. To act on one, click

**Create Evaluator**in its Next Steps to track the pattern with an online eval, then test the fix in an experiment. No issues yet? The first review may not have run, or the project has no traces.

## Configure Signal

Open
**⋯**→

**Configure Signal**to change the schedule or describe what your agent does and what counts as a failure, then click

**Save**. On Enterprise plans you can also attach a GitHub repo, and Signal opens pull requests for its fixes. It never deploys them. See Signal for setup. Prefer a terminal? The

`ag` CLI enables Signal, lists issues, and triggers a sweep without the UI.
